facts.business: Thirani Projects Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) engaged in lending and investment activities.
key_risks: Revenue recognition and NPA classification compliance with RBI prudential norms for NBFCs
facts.related_party_note: A Related Party Policy has been devised by the Board of Directors for determining the materiality of transactions with related parties and dealings with them. The Audit Committee reviews all related party transactions quarterly. Necessary approval of the Audit Committee and the Board of Directors were taken wherever required.
